name: Millia -Đoạn kết-
source: Long ago, there exists two goddesses, Millia and Hedria, with the duty to protect their world. But then one day, Hedria was angered by human and wanted to destroy the world with her curse. Goddess Millia had to sacrifice herself to temporary stop the curse then reborn again to continue ritual each 20 years. The never-ending cycle has been going for 200 years until she met Rize, the main character and also her guardian. After befriended Rize, she started to realize the world how beautiful the world is.
translation: 很久以前，米莉亞和赫德莉亞兩位女神肩負著守護世界的職責。然而某天，赫德莉亞被人類激怒，想用詛咒毀滅世界。女神米莉亞只得犧牲自己，暫時阻止詛咒，之後重生，每20年繼續進行儀式。這個永無止境的循環持續了200年，直到她遇見主角、也是她的守護者里澤。與里澤成為朋友後，她開始意識到世界是多麼美麗。
